description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this three-bedroom student property, ideally located on the popular Brentwood Avenue in West Jesmond.

Perfectly positioned to take advantage of the fantastic local amenities, the property is within easy reach of Tesco, Waitrose, Starbucks and the popular bars and restaurants along Osborne Road. West Jesmond Metro Station is also nearby, providing convenient transport links across Newcastle and beyond.

The property is ideally situated for students attending both Newcastle University and Northumbria University, making it a great choice for student living.

Interested in viewing? Contact the My Property Box lettings team today to arrange your viewing!
